name: Homebrew Packages
description: Install user-specific Homebrew formulae as an overlay on top of a shared base feature, then remove the Homebrew manager files and default cache to keep the image smaller.

packages.description: Space-delimited Homebrew formula names to install.

username.description: Named non-root passwd user that should own the temporary Homebrew tree while formulae are installed.

cache_directory.description: Directory used for Homebrew bottle downloads during install. Point this at a persistent path if you want to reuse bottles between runs.
